data.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy buys 267 bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
data.description: Michael Saylor's Strategy  (MSTR) is doubling down on its bitcoin (BTC-USD) strategy, acquiring another 267 BTC and repurchasing $193 million worth of its (STRC) preferred stock. Scott Melker breaks down the latest moves, what's driving Saylor's aggressive bitcoin playbook, and what it could mean for Strategy investors.
